file_roles.evidence: In QWinEventNotifier::event, a QPointer alive(this) is taken before emit activated and the post-emit re-registration is guarded with 'alive &&'; the slot may delete the notifier (QProcess), causing use-after-free.

rationale: After emit activated, the code touched d and the waitObject even if a slot destroyed the object. The report shows only a crash, but the commit message names the use-after-free and the diff guards it.
